title: Data Access with ADO.NET
description: Learn how to use ADO.NET to perform CRUD operations, read data efficiently, and build secure, production-ready data access code in ASP.NET Core.
longDescription: This module teaches you how to use ADO.NET for database operations in ASP.NET Core. You will learn about SqlConnection, SqlCommand, SqlDataReader, SqlDataAdapter, parameterized queries, transactions, and best practices for building complete CRUD operations using raw ADO.NET.
whatYouLearn: Understand ADO.NET architecture and connected vs disconnected patterns
Set up SQL Server database and ASP.NET Core project for data access
Use SqlConnection, SqlCommand, and SqlDataReader for efficient reads
Use SqlDataAdapter and DataTable for disconnected data manipulation
Perform complete CRUD operations with parameterized queries
Implement transactions and handle errors gracefully
Follow connection management best practices for production code
